caption: The drawing is in grayscale and depicts the façade of a building with elements of classical architecture. Central to the composition is a structure with a gabled roof topped by a cross. The front of the building features three circular decorative elements and a quatrefoil window above an arched entryway with two columns framing the door. There is a set of wide, curved steps leading up to the entrance. To the left, a partially ruined wall with a rounded archway is present, while on the right, another wall with a large arched opening is visible. The surfaces of the buildings show cracks and weathering marks. At the bottom of the image, a ribbon-shaped banner displays the year "1797" and the words "Misión Santa Margarita." The initials "RC" appear at the lower right edge of the banner. The drawing uses shading to indicate depth and light, with no additional color beyond variations in gray and black.
title: Mision Santa Margarita
